In a stressor-receptor approach, the interaction cells are often ranked or colored by the level of concern based on expert opinion of the likelihood, frequency, and scale of consequence of the interaction as well as regulatory stringency and, potentially, stakeholder concern (e.g., Klure et al. 2012, Exley et al. 2021).
